name: Connection Guard 0.6.2
relationship: Connection Guard 0.6.2 as released (tag 0.6.2 at 74f76c6, published 28 Nov 2026). Shown as "Connection Guard v0.6.2" in the README overview in place of 0.6.1. Same adapter as 0.6.1.
withheld: Held back from the README overview until every family has measured 0.6.2, as for 0.6.1 on 7 Oct 2026 (owner decision); until then the overview keeps 0.6.1's newest results. Remove this field once the families and the five-night optimal series are complete.

shipped.note: As downloaded. New files use operation.mode ENFORCE and block Intel relay, hosting and P2P exits (relay: VPN, hosting: BLOCK, p2p: VPN).

enforce.note: Shipped configuration with operation.mode ENFORCE set explicitly (already the new-install default since 0.6.0).

proxycheck_key.note: enforce + the free ProxyCheck key through the product's documented key field (same key for every product).

free_keys.note: Adds the free ProxyCheck and VPNAPI keys through the product's documented key fields.

optimal.note: Same settings as for 0.6.1 (METHODOLOGY 4): failover order zowi, Blackbox (confirmed by Intel's hosting list), IPQuery; ProxyCheck off. These equal 0.6.2's new-install template, which adds hedge-ms 300 and the Intel relay/hosting/P2P blocks.

documented_failure_policy: failure-policy.vpn: OPEN; FAILOVER zowi -> Blackbox (Intel hosting confirmation) -> IPQuery, with the next service joining after 300 ms (hedge-ms); ProxyCheck off, ip-check.net and IP-API off. Bundled Tor list and signed Connection Guard Intel lists are checked locally first; Intel relay, hosting and P2P hits count as VPN (config.yml, docs/PROVIDER_RESILIENCE.md, CHANGELOG 0.6.2).
telemetry: Connection Guard Cloud heartbeat to api.connectionguard.net (blocked at network level for every product's telemetry)
list_sources_note: Connection Guard Intel lists the shipped configuration downloads; from 0.6.2 relay.txt, hosting.txt and p2p.txt decide too. Intel is built from the same operator server lists as this dataset's VPN labels and from two of the proxy cohort's lists: its coverage here is circular (see the circularity table).
